correctness.rationale: Single-letter deletions characterize minimality by subsequence transitivity. A candidate with at least six runs contains the proper absent subsequence 10101. For two runs the embeddings of 0^p1^q have capacity corners (a,b+d) and (a+c,d); reversal handles 1^p0^q and gives the four missing corners after the single-letter cases. For 0^p1^q0^r, if p<=a or r<=e an embedding of the appropriate proper suffix or prefix extends to the whole word; hence both bounds must be exceeded. Decreasing either outside run and requiring an embedding forces p=a+1,r=e+1, and q>1 would preserve both obstructions after an interior deletion. With q=1 the merged-zero deletion needs c>=2. The pattern 1^p0^q1^r instead has box capacities b,c,d, so only one coordinate can exceed by one with the others equal to one. The zero deletion for the two excess-one-run cases requires d>=2 or b>=2; the excess-zero-run case always passes. For four runs beginning in zero the suffix forces capacities b,c,d, leaving only an excess first run a+1 with all other runs singleton; the internal deletions give c,d>=2. Reversal gives the other four-run case. The proper prefix and suffix of a five-run candidate starting in zero force all five capacities. Starting in one leaves only 10101, whose internal deletions require b,c,d>=2. These templates are distinct, and exactly their stated threshold conditions apply. For a fixed set of k satisfied thresholds there are 2+k free increments after a minimum length 5+k; its count is binom(n-4,k+1). The eight indicator patterns produce multiplicities 1,3,1,2,1 at K=7,8,9,10,13 respectively, giving the stated series, probabilities and leading deficit 40/n. Independent greedy-prefix and deletion-state enumeration in /workspace/branches/audit_word_obstructions.py matched complete antichains for all 1024 tuples in [1,4]^5. This supports, but is not the proof of, the symbolic result.
